title: Chained Eau De Cologne For Men,Amber Wood Eau De Cologne, 3.4 FL.OZ Long Lasting Woody Citrus Scent Perfume For Men, Ideal Gift Set
body_html:
Chained Eau de Cologne for Men,Amber Wood Eau de Cologne, 3.4 FL.OZ Long Lasting Woody Citrus Scent Perfume for Men, Ideal Gift Set
1.This men’s eau de cologne delivers a sophisticated, timeless amber woody fragrance crafted for modern gentlemen. Housed in a sleek gradient glass bottle matched, it boasts a generous 100ml (3.4 fl.oz) capacity, suitable for daily commutes, business occasions, dates and outdoor trips. The balanced layered aroma leaves a gentle, lingering trail all day long.
2.Rich Layered Scent Notes
Top Notes: Lime & Fresh Citrus
Zesty bright lime mixed with vibrant citrus opens the scent, bringing a refreshing, crisp cooling touch to refresh your senses at first spritz.
Middle Notes: Orris Root & Soft Jasmine
Mellow orris root blends with subtle jasmine floral aroma, smoothing out the sharp citrus and adding elegant, understated softness.
Base Notes: Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Oak Moss & Vetiver
Warm sandalwood and rich amber form the core warm woody tone, paired with mild musk, earthy oak moss and grounded vetiver. The deep, steady base lingers on skin and clothes for hours, creating a mature, masculine vibe.
